model: RandomForestClassifier (n_estimators=500, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values; features: all columns except followup_score
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score nearly perfectly separates outcome (likely leakage, measured after diagnosis), so it was excluded; including it gives test accuracy 0.927 but is not a valid predictor.
